figurative_meaning_en: The skeletal frame of the body (emaciated due to hunger or illness)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দারিদ্র্যের কারণে সে হাড় পাঁজরা হয়ে গেছে।
অসুস্থতায় তার শরীর হাড় পাঁজরা বেড়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to poverty, he has become skin and bones.
Illness has left her body as a mere skeletal frame.
note: Often used to describe extreme thinness from malnutrition, deeply embedded in Bengali expressions of hardship.
